assessment: This study presents a valuable single-cell sequencing dataset of fruitless-expressing neurons in the male and female Drosophila nervous system. The quality data and convincing analyses allowed the authors to conclude that most neuronal types are present in both Drosophila sexes, suggesting that sex-specific versions of the transcription factor Fruitless can modify neural function in a sex-specific way without completely altering core neural identity. This work will be of interest to developmental biologists and neuroscientists with a focus on sex-specific differences.
